# SRC-11 source generation and replay

This opt-in qualification procedure targets only immutable release 404941931,
v1.14.4 at 166262365d506157b99968105c890f480cc7c07c. Read the Phase4A-07
contract at cpamp-plan main commit 26b5d6bde1c30e8187135c87a8b84b6c808f23f0.
All 49 cases remain pending until their own actual required evidence exists.

The runner checks that Manager source, harness and controlled profile are
committed before embedding GeneratorCodeCommit. The published executable is
verified/extracted through existing deployment pins; its Go build information
must independently bind vcs.revision to the source commit, vcs.modified=false,
and a recorded Go toolchain/module graph. Archive identity, executable identity
and generated database provenance are three different checks.

Download the named Linux AMD64 archive and release-info.json from the immutable
v1.14.4 release into a unique scratch directory. Verify them against the pins
in legacyartifact/artifact.go. With Docker and the pinned Debian image available:

```sh
python3 bin/qualification/run-src11.py generate \\
  --archive <scratch>/cpa-manager-plus_v1.14.4_linux_amd64.tar.gz \\
  --release-info <scratch>/release-info.json --output <new-generation-root>
python3 bin/qualification/run-src11.py replay \\
  --archive <scratch>/cpa-manager-plus_v1.14.4_linux_amd64.tar.gz \\
  --evidence <new-generation-root>/src-11 --output <new-replay-root>
```

Generation runs in a private Linux AMD64 container with no network, a read-only
root, no capabilities, no published ports, read-only producer/input mounts and
only a task-owned writable output plus private tmpfs. The local fake CPA queue
is wholly inside that network namespace. It delivers four controlled events
plus a duplicate. It is a controlled INPUT, not a synthetic DB or a live CPA
qualification. The authentic old executable creates schema, encrypts its own
connection settings, normalizes and persists usage, dedupes, prices, observes
quota/reset/cooldown state and completes its migrations. It receives price and
quota writes through its own historical HTTP handlers. No SQL fixture insertion,
schema construction, metadata/version edit or production source grant occurs.

All credentials and example.invalid account identities are disposable fixture
values. Source data.key is generated by the old process, sealed with its encrypted
settings, and needed to independently verify key matching. No production keys or
data are used. Historical local fail_body stays local; JSONL exports must omit
raw_json/fail_body and sentinel secrets. Record sensitive environment parameters
as safe profile references. No real CPA queue, supervisor or installed server is
started or modified.

The process first persists its disposable CPA binding through the old
`/usage-service/config` handler, then is signalled and waited on; a nonzero exit
or missing reap fails.
Stopped DB/WAL/SHM/journal inventory is captured before an explicit SQLite
checkpoint. Integrity, foreign keys, completed Cache/Quota migration state and
revision 2 are checked. Logical authoritative fields must survive checkpoint.
The existing maintenancebundle primitive seals the entire file inventory,
including config/key/archives and explicit missing sidecars/roots. Pins and
content/inventory are rechecked after sealing. Source-generation record/index
and outer runner build/execution logs are separately hashed. Generation success
is never a case PASS or a trusted hop receipt.

Replay restores into a new private root and uses existing v2 schema/data
migration, quota, retained/hourly/pricing projections, backup and restore
primitives. It checks all original authoritative columns (including IDs, hashes,
tokens, NULL, raw JSON and metadata); only named accounting derived columns may
change. It compares each model's actual v1 and v2 USD costs with independent
profile arithmetic, checks manual sync protection and explicit zero, duplicate
import, sanitization, quota/reset/cooldown preservation and Devin revision 2.
SEM-09 runs on a labelled v2 retention descendant: publish/verify archives, then
delete raw in bounded production batches and assert retained cost/coverage.
The sealed source remains full raw with no archives/deletion. That descendant
does not count as a separately generated RET case.

Revalidation checks the pinned archive/executable, immutable release-info,
process lifecycle, committed controlled input, generation evidence file digests,
source logical snapshot, complete bundle inventory/digest and matching assets.
Self-consistent JSON alone is not authentication. Independent acceptance must
inspect the exact committed runner/harness, outer actual execution evidence and
replay, or regenerate using the pinned asset. These files never enter production
admission/ExecuteHop/ValidateHop. Lane D provider acceptance and independent
SRC-11 acceptance must be reported separately; this slice cannot mark all 07
or Phase4A complete. Other cases stay pending.

Windows runs replay of the SAME Linux-generated sealed input with its native
SQLite/path/bundle implementation. It does not claim Windows old-producer or
hop execution. Linux generation and native Windows replay are distinct evidence.
